findings.symptom: The FROZEN record format assumes the plugin is live, so three required fields have no legitimate source for a hand-written record authored during this wave: (i) basis.kind — blindness 'must be provable from the plugin's own observation log' (guardTool), which does not exist in the running process (T-21 module caching), so the honest value is 'unproven', and refusal 3 (bind-unproven) REFUSES 'unproven' + PASS; (ii) loopId — created by mpd_verify_open, which does not exist yet; (iii) evidenceId provenance — refusal 2 (forged-evidence) requires an evidenceId produced through mpd_verify_evidence for this loop, which also does not exist yet. Consequence: once the validator lands, every Lane E PASS written in this wave is structurally REFUSED, and acceptance criterion 6 has no validatable artifact.
findings.expected: One captain ruling defining the wave's bootstrap values BEFORE the per-lane records are written: either admit basis.kind:'blind' for wave-authored records carrying unlockedReads: [] plus an explicit absence-of-boot-line attestation, or introduce a third pre-plugin basis kind; plus a loopId convention (e.g. 'waveloop-<lane>') and the rule that evidenceId provenance is satisfied by the logPath+logSha256 pair on disk for this wave.
findings.docSource: verify-law-spec §(b) record fields + refusals 2/3/5 and the two-way ratchet; captain ruling 1 (record format frozen, Lane E writes by hand)

findings.symptom: Cross-clause contradiction between AC1/AC7 and the verifier envelope: the whitelisted gate runner's FIXED table offers only gates, tests, typecheck, docs, manifest, comments, rows, dist, pack — there is NO id for the vendor gate (AC1's acceptance command is `node scripts/verify-vendor.ts`) and none for the Docker lane (AC7's LAST step), while the envelope DENIES `bash` to a verifier seat. A conforming verifier therefore cannot produce AC1's named evidence.

findings.docSource: contract §Acceptance criteria AC1 + AC7; verify-law-spec §(c) whitelisted gate runner and the DENIED list
